description:

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Activision has confirmed the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer beta dates, which begin on August 21. The company also revealed how you can get it, what's in the beta, and when to expect more details. Read on to learn more.

Modern Warfare 4 beta dates

Early access to the open beta runs August 21-25 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. The multiplayer beta then opens for everyone, regardless of preorder status, from August 28-September 1. The open beta also brings in Switch 2 as a supported platform.

How to get in

The early access period is available for people who preorder Modern Warfare 4, but the open beta is free and available to everyone. The fine print also states that an "online multiplayer subscription" may be required.
title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Dates, Content, And How To Get In

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
How does a sex toy shop stand out in the modern era of easily obtainable neck massagers and bedside buddies? The answer is surprisingly easy, as all you have to do is look at a popular IP and put in some elbow grease to transform that idea into a surprisingly cute nightstand buddy. Which is exactly what one company has done, with the return of its line of Pokemon--or Pokemoan--sex toys.

These will go on sale starting July 21, and let's see Pokemon scalpers try and ruin this launch.
title: The Original Pokemon Starters Are Ready To Make You Pokemoan

author: Vic Hood
description:
Collecting bones in Phasmophobia is a great way to earn extra rewards and set yourself an additional (sometimes frustrating) challenge, but it's also crucial to achieving a perfect investigation. Each contract, one bone randomly spawns in the investigation area, offering you and your ghost hunting team the option to find it. But, unlike cursed objects, bones have no set spawn locations, so locating them—especially on larger maps— can be hard work.

But it’s well worth finding them, even if they don’t count as evidence, as collecting a bone offers a cash and XP reward, with the latter critical to achieving Prestige level. On smaller ma
title: How To Find Bones In Phasmophobia

author: Vic Hood
description:
In Phasmophobia, the Spirit Box is a piece of equipment that you can use to gather Spirit Box evidence, helping you to identify the ghost you're dealing with. When used under the right conditions, players can use the Spirit Box to communicate with the ghost by asking valid questions or saying recognized phrases. If the ghost has Spirit Box as one of its pieces of evidence, it will likely respond--though higher difficulty levels with less evidence may impact this.

Its responses may not necessarily prove useful in identifying it, but any response counts as valid Spirit Box evidence and takes you one step closer to determining your spectre. In addition, using the Spirit Box can also be useful when trying to identify a certain ghost’s unique abilities. For
title: All Phasmophobia Spirit Box Questions and Responses

With San Diego Comic-Con kicking off this weekend, Hot Toys has unveiled several new sixth-scale figures, including a Luna Snow collectible that's going to make Marvel Rivals fans very happy. This is the first sixth-scale Marvel Rivals figure from the company, and like all of its other collectibles in this line, it's an impressive-looking replica of the South Korean K-Pop idol turned cryokinetic superhero.

When it comes to figures that show plenty of skin, Hot Toys usually uses a specialized silicone body to make them look as life-like as possible. The Luna Snow figure follows this approach, and she's dressed in her default Marvel Rivals costume that features a blue, black, and white color scheme. title: Hot Toys’ New Marvel Rivals Figure Is Going To Make A Certain Kind Of Collector Very Happy

author: Grace Benfell
description:
Bastion is celebrating its 15-year anniversary today, July 20, 2026. Below, we reexamine Bastion's relationship with divinity in light of Supergiant's later hit, Hades.

"The Ura feared the gods," Bastion's narrator says. "We turned them into trinkets, put them on our walls." In this simple bit of flavor text, there is an implication of religious cultures. The Ura: outsiders, but ones with some shared religious tradition. "We:" a society shared with the narrator, which trivialized that tradition. The details of Bastion's religions are kept mostly vague. One deity, the bull god Pyth, gets a level dedicated to him, but most are relegated to a sentence or two. This lets Bastion's religious world exist in texture and implication. 

When developer Supergiant Games revisited Bastion's religious ideas much more explicitly and elaborately in Hades and its sequel, it did so with
title: It’s Time We Admit That Hades Isn’t Supergiant’s Best Game About Temperamental Gods

description:
Activision has clarified a key detail about the upcoming Call of Duty movie from director Peter Berg and writer Taylor Sheridan. At Fanatics Fest this weekend, Berg confirmed that the movie takes place in the Modern Warfare universe.

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Nintendo has a good track record when it comes to keeping secrets, and in the case of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, the Breath of the Wild sequel's announcement was one of the company's most confidential projects. In fact, the game's existence was so secret that many Nintendo employees only found out about it when it was teased during the E3 2019 Nintendo Direct livestream.

According to former Nintendo of America marketing and PR leads Kit Ellis and Krysta Yang, Tears of the Kingdom had a "higher level" of security than any other Nintendo project that they worked on, and they claimed that only a small handful of people at NoA knew about it.
title: Most Nintendo Employees Found Out About Tears Of The Kingdom When You Did
